senses.gloss: 1. मृष्ट॑ mfn. (for 2. See p. 831, col. 1.) washed, cleansed, polished, clean, pure (lit. and fig.), RV. &c. &c.
smeared, besmeared with (instr.), R.; Naiṣ.
prepared, dressed, savoury, dainty, R.; Hariv.; Var. (cf. मिष्ट)
sweet, pleasant, agreeable, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
मृष्ट॑ n. pepper, L.
2. मृष्ट mfn. (for 1. and 3. See under √ मृज् and 3. मृष्) touched, W.
3. मृष्ट mfn. (for 1. and 2. See under √ मृज् and मृश्) sprinkled, W.
मृष्ट , मृष्टि. See under √ मृज्, मृश् and 3. मृष्.
मृष्ट—कुण्डल mfn. wearing polished or bright earrings, BhP.
मृष्ट—गन्ध m. (prob.) an agreeable smell or savour, Suśr.
मृष्ट—गन्ध—पवन m. a fragrant wind, VarBṛS.
मृष्ट—तम mfn. exceedingly delicate or savoury, Suśr.
मृष्ट—यशस् mfn. of pure glory or renown, BhP.
मृष्ट—लुञ्चित mfn. torn up and washed (as a root), g. राज-दन्तादि.
मृष्ट—वत् mfn. containing a form of √ 1. मृज्, ŚāṅkhŚr.
मृष्ट—वाक्य mfn. speaking sweetly, VarBṛS. (v.l. मिष्ट-व्˚).
मृष्ट—शलाक prob. w.r. for अष्ट-शलाक, (an umbrella) having eight ribs, Hcat.
मृष्ट—सलिल mfn. having bright or pure water, MBh.
मृष्टानुलेपन mfn. smeared with ointment, R.
मृष्टाशन mfn. eating dainty food, Viṣṇ., Sch.
मृष्टाशिन् mfn. id., Viṣṇ.
1. मृ॑ष्टि f. (for 2. See p. 831, col. 1) cleansing, preparation, dressing (of food), MaitrS.; Kāṭh.
a savoury repast, Mn. iii, 255.
2. मृष्टि f. (for 1. and 3. See ib.) touching, contact, W.
3. मृष्टि f. (for 1. and 2. See ib.) sprinkling, W.
मृष्टेरुक mfn. eating dainties or delicacies, luxurious, selfish, L.
liberal, L.
मृश् [cf. Lat. mulceo.]
2. मृश् (ifc.) one who strokes or touches, MW.
2. मृष् (ifc.) one who bears or endures, bearing, MW.
3. मृष् (cf. √ 1. मृष्) cl. 1. P. Ā. मर्षति, ˚ते, to sprinkle, pour out, Dhātup. xvii, 57.
मृशीत mfn. See under वि-√ मृश्.
मृषित See अप-मृषित.
2. मृशय v.l. for मृचय.
मृषाय Nom. Ā. to ˚यते to err, be mistaken, hold a wrong notion or opinion, BhP.
मृशाखान v.l. for मूसा-ख्˚.
मृ॑षा ind. in vain, uselessly, to no purpose, RV. &c. &c.

wrongly, falsely, feignedly, lyingly, AV. &c. &c. (with √ कृ, to feign; with √ ज्ञा or मन्, to consider false or untrue; मृषैव तत्, that is wrong; वरनीयम् मृषा बुधैः, untruthfulness is to be avoided by the wise)
‘Untruth’ personified as the wife of A-dharma, BhP.
मृषा—ज्ञान n. false knowledge, ignorance, folly, Kathās.
मृषा—त्व n. incorrectness, falsity, Śaṃk.
मृषा—दान n. ‘false gift’, feigned or insincere promise of a gift, MBh.
मृषा—दृष्टि mfn. having a false view or opinion, BhP.
मृषा—ध्यानिन् or मृषा—ध्यायिन्, m. ‘feignedly meditative’, Ardea Nivea (a species of crane compared to a religious hypocrite), L.
मृषा—ध्यानिन् or मृषा—ध्यायिन्, m. ‘feignedly meditative’, Ardea Nivea (a species of crane compared to a religious hypocrite), L.
मृषा˚नुशासिन् (मृषान्˚) mfn. punishing unjustly, MBh.
मृषा—भाषिन् mfn. speaking falsely, a liar, Rājat.
मृषा˚र्थ mfn. (मृषार्˚) having a false sense meaning, untrue, absurd, Pracaṇḍ.
मृषा—˚र्थ—क mfn. id., L.
मृषा—˚र्थ—क n. an impossibility, absurdity (e.g. horn on a rabbit &c.), W.
मृषा—वचन n.
मृषा—वाच् f. untrue speech, sarcasm, irony, Kāv.
मृषा—वाद m. id., MBh.
lying (with Buddhists one of the 10 sins), Dharmas. 56
मृषा—वाद mfn. = next, R.
मृषा—वादिन् mfn. speaking falsely, a liar, R.
मृषा—वादिन् m. a false accuser, W.
मृषा—साक्षिन् mfn. false witness, L.
मृषोद्य mfn. speaking untruthfully, a liar, L.
to be spoken falsely, uttered untruthfully, Śiś.
मृषोद्य n. untrue speech, lying, a lie, Āpast.
मृषालक m. the mango tree, L.
